display_long_description:
[media]
# 🔴🔵 Squad Royale: Red vs Blue

The fight just got bigger. Step into **team-based battles** where Red faces Blue in chaotic, high-energy matchups. **Fight together**, control the floor, and push your team to the top.

# 💰 Earn Coins. Get Stronger. 🪙

Earn coins for **every kill**🥊, boost rewards with **finishers**, and secure bonuses by placing in the **Top 3** 🏆. Climb the weekly leaderboard for the biggest payouts.

[media]

# 🧪 Unlock the Chemical Path

Start with the **Acid Gun**, upgrade to the **Acid Cannon**, and reach the **Plasma Corruptor** ⚡ — more damage, more pressure, more control.


# 🥊 Finish Strong

Finishers give you control over the final moment — turning every win into a visible, player-driven outcome.

**💥 Brain Blaster** — fast, clean, final.
[media]
**😈 Devil’s Hand** — close, controlled, personal.
[media]
**🩸 Gut Ripper** — aggressive, high-impact, unforgettable.
Now you can also become a **Butcher** and end the fight with the **Gut Ripper**


# Club Fight

A **multiplayer combat experience** where fights become public moments.

🔥 Fast, physical, unpredictable fights — **now with team play**. 

💬**https://discord.gg/aNgksnfvGN**
